description: OCHA's office for the occupied Palestinian territory publishes interactive charts, maps and databases for humanitarian responders on its data page. The pages read on 2026-09-28 include a Gaza electricity series built from data the Gaza Electricity Distribution Company sends OCHA every day, with demand estimated from each day's temperature, set against a chronic supply deficit that the page links to failing health, water and sanitation services; charts of people and goods moving through Gaza's crossings with Israel and Egypt and at the shore, in one set for October 2023 to January 2025 and one for earlier years; and a West Bank database of demolished Palestinian-owned structures and resulting displacement since 2009, updated within about 48 hours of an incident, whose structure types include homes, livelihood buildings and infrastructure such as water pipes, roads and network facilities. Further items cover casualties, Area C demolition orders and needs assessments. Coverage is the West Bank and Gaza Strip. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): UN terms of use: personal, non-commercial use only, no redistribution or derivative works without permission. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the page does not state export formats, and the crossing figures carry caveats about what the UN could observe. It supports emergency and cascading failure studies, such as linking electricity supply to water and health service disruption. Related records: the Gaza electricity company damage case study and the Gaza hospital attacks dataset.
